D_vikings_cover_standard.text: COVER PRODUCTION STANDARD: This is a finished full-color portrait comic-book cover, not an interior story page. Sell one dominant issue-specific contradiction, desire or pressure in one glance. Preserve Vikings 2026's grounded painted documentary-comedy realism, human dignity, ordinary present-day New York, clean focal hierarchy and strong thumbnail readability. Prefer iconic issue-specific staging over recap collage. Do not default to generic cast lineups, floating-head montage, fake action, decorative runes, fantasy spectacle, caricature, or invented promotional clutter. Humor must come from incompatible systems and ordinary New York indifference rather than making the displaced Norse characters look foolish. Preserve a clean masthead/trade-dress field. Do not reveal later issue solutions, reversals, rulings or end-state payoffs beyond the recipe's explicit spoiler ceiling.

D_vikings_cover_trade_dress.text: COVER TRADE-DRESS REFERENCE GATE: Before generating any Vikings 2026 cover, retrieve and visually pixel-read the approved local Issue 1 reference at production/references/vikings-2026/assets/covers/issue-01-cover-trade-dress.jpg. It is an exact copy of the released StarSplitterVisions Issue 1 cover. Use those pixels as authority for the white upper masthead field; boxed Star Splitter / VISIONS publisher mark at upper left; year-and-issue block within that badge; huge dark condensed VIKINGS 2026! wordmark; thin horizontal rules; narrow all-caps strapline beneath the wordmark; border/spacing rhythm; and the transition from masthead into painted cover art. Use it for cover branding only. Do NOT copy Issue 1's waiting-room scene composition, character arrangement, camera angle, background or issue-specific art into later covers unless the current cover recipe independently requires it. The current issue recipe controls the selling image.
